name: Zendriver Browser Backend
description: Stealth-patched Chromium driven over CDP via the zendriver Python lib. Hides navigator.webdriver, fakes chrome.runtime, and synthesizes real OS-level keyboard/mouse events through Input.dispatchKeyEvent / dispatchMouseEvent / synthesizeScrollGesture. The right backend for any site with anti-bot detection (Reddit, Cloudflare, Akamai, PerimeterX). Spawns a long-lived Python helper subprocess (./helper/browser_helper.py) for the CDP traffic — torn down on close. Registers as the 'zendriver' selector via api.registerBrowserBackend; the browser-core plugin owns the `browser` tool and routes to it.
